dedupe_keys.name: digital map data ready to be consumed by camber pilot 2 dt

description: The source describes road-map inputs for the CAMBER Pilot 2 CARLA digital twin in Trikala. The OpenDRIVE component is derived from a Trikala OSM map and adds two traffic lights and two signs, including a 30 km/h limit and a pedestrian caution sign. A companion deposit by the same institution provides the OSM component and is grouped here, with distinct native identities retained. The metadata do not identify the original OSM snapshot date, exact geographic extent or a validated coordinate conversion. Both deposits are restricted. Earlier similarly titled Trikala simulation deposits remain separate unresolved leads because exact version relationships are not established. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
